items.item:
7. A change whose transaction fails writes no entry and leaves the audit
   sequence as it was; the next accepted change takes the number after it.
   Shows A15-1. [witness: verification:registry_a15_failed_change_leaves_sequence_unchanged]
statements:
```text
for entries e1 written before e2: e1.sequence < e2.sequence   -- A15-1
erase(d) accepted => no entry with instant < start_of(d) remains   -- A15-2
erase(d) accepted => its erasure entry e has e.instant >= start_of(d)   -- A15-3
```

verdicts.item:
7. A change whose transaction fails writes no entry and leaves the audit
   sequence as it was; the next accepted change takes the number after it.
   Shows A15-1. [witness: verification:registry_a15_failed_change_leaves_sequence_unchanged]
statements:
```text
for entries e1 written before e2: e1.sequence < e2.sequence   -- A15-1
erase(d) accepted => no entry with instant < start_of(d) remains   -- A15-2
erase(d) accepted => its erasure entry e has e.instant >= start_of(d)   -- A15-3
```
verdicts.why: The check detects that the failed transaction adds no audit entry and does not advance the stored sequence, then verifies that the next accepted change receives exactly the number after the last written entry.
